gpu.note: Primary GPU statistics exclude warm-up, frame errors, invalid/out-of-range instances and incomplete owned-process inventories. Owned PID counters are combined per physical engine; the busiest engine is not whole-GPU percent. Process GPU-memory counters are accounted allocations, not unique physical VRAM; system adapter memory is context only.

reviewRules.privateGrowthMiB: greater than max(32 MiB, 10% opening median) with positive Theil-Sen slope
reviewRules.handleGrowth: greater than max(100, 10% opening median) with positive Theil-Sen slope
reviewRules.processGrowth: closing median exceeds opening median by more than one, with positive slope

analysis.assessment: Review flagged observations; these thresholds do not diagnose a leak.
limitations: CPU complete-cohort intervals and partial matched lower bounds are reported separately. Short-lived child processes born and exited between samples are not captured.
Process identity uses PID plus creation time; CPU never crosses a reused PID, counter regression, failed query or a long sample gap.
Working set is a sum of process working sets and can double-count shared pages; private bytes are committed process-private allocations, not total physical memory.
Late-window medians, peaks, OLS and Theil-Sen slopes describe this workload/window only; caching and renderer churn need context.
Tree ownership is established by the collector. Aggregates cannot reconstruct processes never sampled or independently prove ownership from grouped counters alone.
Native attachment and renderer reports are distinct from human desktop visibility. Missing samples/lifecycle events do not prove absence of lock/sleep.

GPU engine usage is the busiest accounted physical engine, not whole-GPU percent. Process GPU memory is not unique physical VRAM; system adapter memory is context only. Power/energy are not measured by this collector; no zero-leak guarantee is made.

Each scenario is a 120-second resource sample, not a two-hour soak or leak proof.
PROCESS_COVERAGE_PARTIAL and GPU_COUNTER_COVERAGE_PARTIAL are measurement notes only when explicit CPU/GPU/memory coverage thresholds are met; all original flags and counts remain reported.
GPU is busiest accounted engine and process memory accounting, not whole-GPU percent, unique VRAM or watts.
The manager remains open; costs include the complete owned tree.
No manual visual, lock/logon, sleep, hotplug or mixed-DPI test. Renderer reports do not prove visible presentation.
CAS transactions preserve original content but advance revisions, history and receipts.
Interrupted or forced-killed runners require explicit --recover; concurrent changes or a different host session prevent automatic overwrite.
Recovery-only summaries omit private journal phase contents; recoveredPhaseCount is a bounded count, not evidence that those samples passed.
